readings: In `player_college`, give each college (by `college_id`, with records lacking a college_id treated as one group) a count equal to its number of distinct players (`player_id`), so each player counts once per college. Find the colleges whose count is strictly above the average count across all colleges. Return a single row with: (1) the average count among those colleges; (2) the average of each such college's count divided by the total of the counts summed over all colleges; and (3) the average amount by which their counts exceed the all-college average count. Do not round.
queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c
)
SELECT
  AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count,
  AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total) AS avg_share,
  AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM c, s
WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt;
